content:
mia: Who's doing an office March-style playoff bracket this year? I'm starting one for the company pot. $2 buy-in, winner gets donuts + shame wall photo. :trophy: :doughnut:
dez: count me in. but can we please have a better tiebreaker than 'closest score'? it always ties. :grimacing:
ryan: i vote for tiebreaker = total points of the final game + 10% of your fantasy lineup score. kidding. maybe just 'total margin' or predict final score?
tasha: predict the final game's total points sounds fair. also can we have an "upset bonus" where anyone who picks an underdog that wins gets a side prize? :eyes:
mia: love the upset bonus. rules draft in 2 mins:
```
- $2 entry
- single-elim bracket, standard seeding
- tiebreaker: predict final game's combined points (closest wins)
- upset bonus: 5 bonus points per correct upset pick (for tie-break weighting)
- payout: 70% winner, 20% runner-up, 10% office snack fund
```
dez: @mia spreadsheet? would like to see the live bracket.
mia: spreadsheet here: https://tiny.redwood/bracket-2026 (i'll post signups there). post emoji to confirm.
ryan: sign me up :basketball:  (i'm bad at brackets and proud)
tasha: sign me up :raised_hands:  also proposing a quick emoji poll — anyone want an extra $1 potato chip tax to buy snacks for the viewing party? :potato:
ops-bot: Poll created: "Snack tax for viewing party?" Options: 👍 Yes $1, 👎 No. Expires in 24h.
dez: also suggestion: loser has to wear a rival team's cap in the kitchen for a day. high-stakes humiliation. :smiling_imp:
mia: only if the cap is provided. budget from the 10% snack fund? :sweat_smile:
ryan: deal. i'll sponsor the cap if i win. which obviously i will not.
tasha: small PSA: if you pay via Venmo, put your slack handle in the note so i can track entries.
mia: added to the sheet: column "paid" and "handle". i'll lock signups 30 mins before first game.
dez: last Q: can we run a super-late bracket for people in APAC timezones? might be a different pot.
mia: good idea — separate signups, separate payouts. i'll set a second tab.
ops-bot: Event reminder scheduled: "Office Playoff Bracket Signups" Tomorrow 9:00am.
ryan: audio for viewing party? i'll bring my Bluetooth speaker and an embarrassingly loud playlist.
tasha: please no 2008 pump-up remixes, ryan. :pray:
mia: thanks folks. posting final rules and Venmo details in the sheet. good luck, may the least terrible bracket win!
